lagos-del-olimpo.title: Lagos del Olimpo
lagos-del-olimpo.summary: Lagos del Olimpo residential community, located about 800 m before downtown El Carmen de Apicalá, on the main road to Melgar. Lots start at 72 m² (6 x 12 m), with options up to 180 m².
lagos-del-olimpo.details:
Lagos del Olimpo
Residential community about 800 m before downtown El Carmen de Apicalá, on the main road to Melgar. Lot sizes: 72 m² (6 x 12 m), 105 m² (7 x 15 m), 120 m² (8 x 15 m), 150 m² (10 x 15 m), and 180 m² (9 x 20 m). Irregular lot shapes.

Enjoy 7 hectares of shared amenities with your family:
• Sandy beach and lake for water sports
• Extreme water park for adults and children
• Skate park
• Dog park and pet pool
• Sports pool for adults
• Camping area, hammocks, and nature trails

Utilities include water, electricity, and sewer service. The development also has paved roads, gated access, and commercial spaces. Lots start at COP $45 million. Cash buyers receive a COP $2 million discount. Interest-free financing is available: COP $3 million down payment and the balance over 24 months. Reserve yours today.

fincas-del-paso.title: Fincas de San Isidro
fincas-del-paso.summary: Lots from COP $75 million. Strong appreciation potential and a strategic location.
fincas-del-paso.details:
Fincas de San Isidro
The development now has a certificate of title and legal history in the builder's name. The subdivision process is underway to assign an individual property registration number to each lot. Only a few lots remain in the first phase.

Country lots of 2,000 m² and up, located in El Carmen de Apicalá, Tolima, Colombia. Prices start at COP $78 million. Interest-free financing directly through the builder for up to 30 months. Located in the 4 Esquinas district, 27 minutes from the main town square. Reserve with COP $1 million; down payment from COP $5 million. Free construction.

Planned amenities: mixed adult and children's pool, gazebo and BBQ area, stream and waterfall, natural ecosystem, green spaces, Tejo court, lookout point, water and electricity, compacted roads, and paved tracks on steep sections. Each lot has its own subdivision and current legal documentation, plus an approved urban development license.

brisas-del-rio.title: Brisas del Río
brisas-del-rio.summary: Open-construction residential development in Cunday, Tolima. Lots from 72 m².
brisas-del-rio.details: 600 lots starting at 72 m². Prices vary by location and lot size. Contact us to reserve a lot with COP $1,000,000. Financing is available for 28 to 36 months, depending on the lot price. No interest, guarantor, or credit check required.

parcelacion.title: Oasis del Olimpo Country Lots
parcelacion.summary: The Oasis del Olimpo development has everything for a relaxing getaway. Lots start at 105 m² (7 x 15 m).
parcelacion.details:
Oasis del Olimpo Country Lots
An urban development with everything you need for rest and recreation. Lots start at 105 m² (7 x 15 m). Prices start at COP $42 million, with interest-free financing. Reserve with COP $3 million and pay the balance over 24 months. Get a COP $2 million discount when paying in cash.

Amenities include an adults' and children's water park, multi-use court, synthetic soccer field, gated entrance, green spaces, and visitor parking. Located in El Carmen de Apicalá, Tolima, an area with strong appreciation potential.

fincas-del-olimpo.title: Fincas Agroturísticas El Paso
fincas-del-olimpo.summary: Country lots from 1,000 m² in El Carmen de Apicalá, Tolima. Interest-free financing directly through the builder.
fincas-del-olimpo.details:
Fincas Agroturísticas El Paso
A wonderful development located in El Carmen de Apicalá, Tolima, on the road to El Paso. Lots start at 1,000 m². Prices start at COP $73 million for cash purchases and COP $75 million with installments.

Planned amenities and services: pool area, lake for water sports, gazebo, nature trail, outdoor fitness park, dock, private water system, solar-powered street lighting, and free construction. The septic system is the buyer's responsibility. Interest-free financing directly through the builder for up to 24 months.

villas-del-olimpo.title: Villas del Olimpo
villas-del-olimpo.summary: Country-style gated community in El Carmen de Apicalá, Tolima.
villas-del-olimpo.details: Country lots in a gated community on the road to El Paso–Girardot, less than 5 minutes from downtown. Lots start at 300 m². An outdoor shopping center will offer commercial spaces from 100 m², starting at COP $150,000,000. Reserve with COP $1,000,000, complete the down payment with COP $4,000,000 the following month, and pay the balance in 30 interest-free installments with no credit check. Financing is provided directly by the builder.
features: Main sewer network and wastewater treatment plant

Multi-use, tennis, padel, and synthetic courts
